who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane flight (V14) under proofs-1113
what: The asks world lands the writes from memory in flight at a crash in the order they were asked; Sim lands them in the order its pending wheel drains them (deadline order), so two in-flight writes to one file land in the other order and, where they overlap, leave bytes the world cannot reach (seed 683 of the refinement: writes 14 at 0 and 16 at 512 of w/a, Sim lands 16 sector 1 then 14 sectors 1 and 2).
cost: three VM rounds and a stop: the lane rule may not be changed
cause: the world fixes an order on concurrent landings that the kernel does not
whys: a crash witness was written as one mask per write in a fixed order; landings were modelled per write, not per sector; nothing checked the witness shape against Sim before the rule was frozen
class: a world witness that fixes an order or grouping the kernel leaves free
prevention: not done: take a crash landing as a list of (write in flight, sector) in landing order, each at most once
workaround: none; reported to the main agent
